bibl.title: Reconsidering the Chronology of Athribis in the Light of Stamped Amphora Handles.
bibl.seg: Haitham Madkour, Reconsidering the Chronology of Athribis in the Light of Stamped Amphora Handles.
bibl.note: Eight stamped amphora handles found during the excavations of the Supreme Council of Antiquities (SCA), Inspectorate of Sohag, in the area of Ptolemy IX Soter II's and Ptolemy XII Auletes' temples at Athribis (Upper Egypt) between 1981 and 1996. - 1. Introduction. - 2. Description: Rhodian eponym stamps [1-2]; - Rhodian fabricant stamps [3-6]; - Koan fabricant stamps [7-8]. - 3. Discussion. - 4. Conclusion.
